preconditions.description: The number of words in the scroll is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each word in the scroll has a length of at least 1.
The sum of the lengths of all words in the scroll does not exceed 20000.
All characters in each word are lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.
The output is the number of ways to get a version of the original scroll from the scroll modulo 10^9 + 7.
